highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.158.0 previews Skia m158 with GPU rendering corrections and an updated HarfBuzzSharp companion.
highlights_body: Preview 2 corrects reflected hairline caps and text-atlas sampling, adds a targeted ARM Vulkan device-loss workaround, and bounds Graphite clip recording. HarfBuzzSharp updates to HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and adds missing named script constants.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to Skia m158 while preserving SkiaSharp's managed API surface.

Corrects zero-length square-capped hairline scaling under reflected transforms and text-atlas sampler selection affected by interpolation imprecision. Graphite flushes when needed to bound clip recording and rejects draws whose clips cannot fit a fresh render pass.
Adds a 1 ms delay on affected device-loss paths for ARM proprietary drivers from 42.0 up to, but not including, 56.0. Ordinary successful submissions are not delayed.

preview_summaries.v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5: Preview 2 adopts GPU drawing corrections and a targeted ARM Vulkan device-loss workaround. Its HarfBuzzSharp companion updates to HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and adds 30 named script constants.
preview_summaries.v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2: Preview 1 opens the 4.158 line with Skia m158 and no SkiaSharp managed API changes. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.300 without changing its HarfBuzz 14.4.0 engine.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates the bundled HarfBuzz engine to 15.0.0 and adds 30 named Script constants, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform and Seal. Existing Script fields, values, parsing and conversions are preserved.

v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2.headline: SkiaSharp 4.158.0 Preview 1 updates the bundled renderer to Skia m158.
v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2.body: The SkiaSharp managed API surface is unchanged. HarfBuzzSharp packages move to revision 14.4.0.300 while the bundled HarfBuzz engine stays at 14.4.0.

v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5.headline: SkiaSharp 4.158.0 Preview 2 corrects GPU drawing and adds a targeted ARM Vulkan device-loss workaround.
v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5.body: It corrects reflected hairline caps and text-atlas sampling, and bounds Graphite clip recording. HarfBuzzSharp updates to HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and adds 30 named script constants while preserving existing Script fields and values.
